description: A local-first desktop app that runs a team of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) on your repository, with independent review before anything merges.
rules: Install the Windows app from the GitHub releases page; it needs Node.js 22 or 24, Git for Windows, and at least one signed-in assistant (claude, codex or gemini).
The desktop window starts and stops the engine itself. For a manual engine use loom daemon start, loom daemon status and loom daemon stop.
Create a private GitHub project with loom team create <path> --name <project-name> (preview it with --dry-run), or register a repository that already has a commit with loom team create <path>.
Plan before work: loom team start "<goal>" --planning, discuss it with loom team chat <run-id>, then approve once with loom team approve <run-id>.
Read the durable result rather than a worker's final message: loom team result <run-id> and loom team diff <run-id>.
Merge the integration branch with loom team merge <run-id>; it updates your checked-out branch and never pushes.
Run loom --help, loom team --help, loom daemon --help or loom github --help for the current command surface; the CLI is authoritative over older examples.
